caption: The drawing is composed of four main sections arranged within a rectangular border. In the top left section, there is a front view illustration of a window with closed shutters on both sides and a central iron grille that features a vertical arrangement of ornamental elements and repeated leaf-like patterns. The bottom left section displays a fence segment with alternating pointed finials and oval-shaped, crisscrossing wrought iron designs along its length, all supported by vertical posts. The top right section illustrates a detailed view of an iron porch structure, showcasing a column and railing adorned with elaborate scrollwork, floral motifs, and repeated geometric patterns, as well as a shaded porch area with several other columns and railing segments extending into the background. In the center, a circular inset features a perspective view of a two-story house with ironwork on its balcony and a fence lining the property. At the lower right below the circular inset, a label reads “ORNAMENTAL IRON WORK ON MOTHER CABRINI’S HOME.” The entire composition is rendered in black ink line drawing on a beige or off-white background, emphasizing the linear detail and decorative features of the ironwork elements.
title: Iron Work
